registry.research_arc_summary: Seven phases of optimization improved full-period return from GGG1 7.14% to Phase7 7.88% (+0.74pp). Calm_trend (26.6% of weeks) is the structural bottleneck. Remaining 0.12pp gap to 8.0% requires PIT stock breadth data (Norgate/WRDS).
registry.calm_trend_bottleneck: calm_trend is 26.6% of all weeks. In calm_trend, the portfolio earns ~4.2% annualized vs SPY 16.87%. No existing feature can distinguish high-return from ordinary calm weeks without PIT stock breadth data. Calm_trend improvement is the single largest remaining opportunity.
